messages:
maya: Heads-up — staging payload bundle for vpc-2026.03.21 build is ready for the delivery window tonight 02:00-03:00 UTC. Need ops + packaging signoff. deploy-bot will run `bundle-and-seal` at 01:45 UTC. Cosign + checksums prepared. ETA ~30m for preflight. @ops-elena @sanjay
liam: Quick Q — are we preserving the previous manifest so rollback is atomic? Which tag do we pin?
sanjay: On packaging: we will pin `installer:release-2026-03-21-v1`. We keep the prior manifest in offsite-mirror/archives for rollback. Rollback trigger = canary failure OR transport checksum mismatch.
ops-elena: Approving window in principle. One constraint: if upload to edge mirrors >20m we hold/abort. Also need explicit abort path in runbook.
liam: Release notes almost done. Will add known issue about KMS env and snippet for customers.
sanjay: Note on airgap bundle size — current tarball ~3.9GB. Transport prefers <4GB, but some older mirrors choke near 4G. We can gzip delta to shrink further. Do we want a split archive instead?
maya: Prefer single archive for customer simplicity. If gzip gets us <4GB that's ideal. If not, fallback to 2-part split with checksums.
packager-bot: packager-bot: delta-gzip job finished. Result: 3.62GB. Checksums attached.
packager-bot: ```sha256: b7f3b2a8d3e6f4c9a1d2e3f4b5c6d7e8f9a0b1c2d3e4f56789ab0c1d2e3f4a5
md5: 4b825dc642cb6eb9a060e54bf8d69288
size_bytes: 3882352896
```
maya: Nice. Are cosign keys rotated since last release? deploy-bot will verify signature after upload.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: preflight scheduled 01:40 UTC. Steps: build image -> cosign sign -> upload to edge -> verify checksums -> publish manifest pointer. Command used in CI:```deploybot release --bundle vpc-2026-03-21-v1 --sign --verify```
liam: I'll attach the release-notes link and the customer-facing upgrade instructions. Also include a snippet showing KMS env vars we recommend:
liam: ```env:
  REDWOOD_KMS_KEY: "projects/prod/keys/rw-private-1"
  REDWOOD_KMS_REGION: "us-west1"
```
ops-elena: Confirming rollback criteria for runbook: 1) canary error rate >1% for 5m 2) upload checksum mismatch 3) post-install critical failers reported by SRE. If any, we revert manifest pointer to `installer:release-2026-03-14-v9` and open incident channel #incident-release.
sanjay: Packaging note — we will keep immutable tags. The pointer `latest-private` will be updated only after canary succeeds.
maya: Canary plan — enable to 2% of traffic for 10m, monitor lat+error, abort if errors exceed threshold.
liam: Release notes: https://go/release-notes/priv-vpc-20260321. Please add short blurb about the cert rotation instructions.
ops-elena: Approving final ship from ops. If deploy-bot reports upload latency >20m we will escalate and pause.
maya: I'll run a final preflight at 01:30 UTC and then trigger deploy-bot at 01:45. Will ping here when signed and uploaded.
packager-bot: packager-bot: cosign signature attached: `cosign:sha256:abc123...def456`
liam: :thumbsup: dropping the release-notes into the docs repo now.
sanjay: Standing by for the preflight logs.
maya: Thanks team — aiming to ship on schedule. If anything blocks, call the rollback and ping #oncall immediately.
